description: Occupation-level visa applicability, separately by visa stream, list statuses and existing mandatory assessment conditions and exemptions. Includes negative and unknown results. Optional visaSubclass filters the options; omitting it returns all. Does not establish personal eligibility. Fees and processing times have separate tools.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

occupation.description: Internal occupationCode from search_occupations, or occupation URL/slug. anzsco is a shared classification code, not a unique identity. Exact internal code matches take precedence; search to select a candidate only if no exact match exists.

visaSubclass.description: For example 482; preserves all its streams. 491 includes the family-sponsored stream; 491F selects only that stream.

name: get_occupation_visas
title: Get occupation visa options
